description.text: 1st Semester (5 Months Theoretical): Tuition: 12,000 RMB (3,400 RMB/Month) Interpretation Fee: 4,500 RMB (900 RMB/Month) Subtotal: 16,500 RMB 2nd Semester (1 Month Theoretical and 3 Months Clinical Practice): Tuition: 16,000 RMB (3400 x 1 + 4200 x 3 = 16,000) Interpretation Fee: 7,500 RMB (900 x 1 + 2200 x 3 = 7,500) Subtotal: 23,500 RMB Note: Interpretation fee is only charged when the teacher gives lessons in English. Certificate is confer on the student who have completed all courses of study. Students could choose to be taught in Chinese and the university will arrange you to study with Chinese students together. Students need to choose courses by themselves and 32 RMB/class hour (50 minutes per class hour).

duration.text: The One-year Acupuncture Course for English Speakers at Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.High school academic transcript 4.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.
